macros.name: hrefdisplayonly
macros.doc: While the (hyperlinked) text appears like an ordinary \href in the compiled .pdf-file, the same text will be “hidden” when printing the text.

macros.name: hycoff
macros.doc: the commands \hycon and \hycoff (hyper-colour-on/off) can be used to simulate switching option ocgcolorlinks of the hyperref package on and off.
